newsitem.title: USA: HIGH PLAINS WHEAT - KANSAS FARMERS MOVING WHEAT.
newsitem.headline: HIGH PLAINS WHEAT - KANSAS FARMERS MOVING WHEAT.

text.p: Kansas growers took advantage of this week's rally in wheat futures and sold part of their crop, grain dealers said Friday.
"This morning's been pretty strong. A lot of producers appear to be selling," a south central Kansas grain dealer said.
Wheat futures have climbed higher so far this week on fund-related buying, traders said.
Separately, one dealer in Oklahoma said his total purchases of wheat this season were running a little ahead of the average pace.
"I'd say we've probably bought about 35 percent of the crop so far, (which is) slightly ahead of average," the dealer said.
Basis bids for HRW wheat were mixed, with some strength reported in Kansas. Gulf bids were slightly weaker, dealers said.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: U=KCBT September. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
